# flatnotes 6.5.0

This release focuses on **code simplification, a more usable mobile Share dialog
and focused security checks** for personal, single-user deployments. Public
Markdown editing remains opt-in and protected-note sharing stays read-only.

## Highlights

- **Simpler backend:** extracted focused FastAPI routers for ordinary notes,
  publications, encrypted notes and attachments, while keeping existing API
  paths. Removed unused note and attachment storage base classes and isolated
  the one-time expiration migration.
- **Cleaner frontend:** reduced redundant API wrappers, removed unused
  properties and state, and simplified search result ordering.
- **Mobile Share:** centered dialogs inside the dynamic viewport, enabled
  internal touch scrolling and kept the Share action buttons accessible on
  short mobile screens. Removed the decorative separator above those buttons.
- **Security checks:** regression tests reject unauthenticated private API
  access. Private attachment downloads now apply `nosniff`, sandbox CSP and
  download disposition for potentially active content; application HTML uses
  a restrictive CSP and no-referrer policy.
- **Better test coverage:** real Chromium smoke tests exercise login, private
  notes, public Markdown editing, encrypted public sharing and compact mobile
  Share layouts, alongside JavaScript, Python and wheel checks.
- **CI/CD:** Docker builds depend on passing package tests. Branch pushes
  publish branch-tagged GHCR images; pull requests build without publishing.
  Development images have a seven-day cleanup workflow. Manual Build runs can
  specify a validated `custom_tag`; release tags and assets remain immutable.
- Updated English and Italian READMEs, wiki documentation and release guidance.

## Compatibility and upgrade notes

- Existing Markdown, `.md.enc`, attachment files and publication SQLite
  metadata retain their formats. No new manual migration is required when
  upgrading from **6.4.0**.
- Back up the complete `FLATNOTES_PATH` directory, including
  `.flatnotes-publications.db`, before upgrading. See
  [Operations and Backup](https://github.com/erathaowl/flatnotes/wiki/Operations-and-Backup).
- Ordinary Markdown notes may still be shared with optional public edit
  permission. Anyone who obtains an edit-enabled URL can change the shared
  content. Public encrypted links remain read-only.
- The previously documented limitation on reusing public slugs after
  expiration cleanup (SEC-02) remains unchanged.
- HTTPS enforcement, HSTS and login rate limiting belong at the trusted
  reverse proxy. The backend must not be exposed directly to the Internet.
  Session tokens remain accessible to browser JavaScript.

## Docker

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/erathaowl/flatnotes:v6.5.0
```

Use a versioned tag for the main instance. The `:master` image tracks
development and `:latest` follows the last published release. Temporary
branch and custom-tag images are intended for evaluation and are eligible
for cleanup after seven days.

## Assets

- `flatnotes-6.5.0-py3-none-any.whl`: Python 3.13 wheel containing the
  FastAPI backend and compiled frontend.
- `flatnotes-6.5.0.tar.gz`: standalone application archive including the
  backend, built frontend, README files and wiki.
- `ghcr.io/erathaowl/flatnotes:v6.5.0` and `:latest`: GHCR Docker images.
